Keep an eye out for hidden quests.
You can show or hide helmets in Settings.
You must save at least once to use Cash Shop.
Search every corner of the map for hidden chests.
Monsters lower level than you may grant no EXP.
Abandon sub quests by pressing * in Quest window.
Most monster special attacks are magic attacks.
You can only use basic attacks while frozen.
Spirit skill Full Immunity cures all status effects.
Spirit skill Wings removes slow effects.
Monsters with red names are stronger than normal.
If game runs slowly, lower visual effects in Settings.
Socket gear is obtained via Combine or monsters.
Combine and synthesize via Skills > General menu.
Standing still regenerates HP and SP faster.
Single heavy blows work better against high DEF foes.
Crafting materials can be obtained from grass or rocks.
Skills like Bombardment can be cancelled by reusing;them.
Enhance skills with traits to gain range or attack;speed.
Quest hints may be hidden in conversations with NPCs.
Relic boxes yield items with reduced level requirements.
You can sell items from abandoned sub quests to shops.

You have already surpassed human limits, Tyr.
I did not come to fight.
I merely came to show you something...
You expect me to trust Kefnes right hand, the oldest servant of the Ancient God?
Were not your enemies the Listeners?
Wrong, it is every remnant left by the Ancient God!
A Mana Cluster Bomb...! Is this... Lurain handiwork?
It is my own preparation to fight your kind.
Is not it about time you revealed your true form...?
No... If you are prepared... to fight... that is enough.
I almost had him... You will not get away!
It seems... already abandoned... Does not look like a trap...
Appears after 5 years just to say his piece and run off.
I need to... see this place?
Do not tell me this is...
A place where things like me are made?
Someone... needed more beings like me...? Seven of them...?
Why are you showing me this place?!
What do you want from me?! Rabi!!
^I will grant you what you desire most.
It has been almost a year. Is that all you know how to say?
If you want to strike a deal, make a proper offer.
Offering what I desire means you want something from me...
Then state your request first. Do not act like you are doing me a favor.
Show yourself before me in person.
You can only talk big in your dreams because you lack the nerve.
Time to work. Stop dozing off.
Let us finish up and get out. Easy job for once, right?
I will take the right. You take the }left{.
It is an old underpass, but there are only a }few goblins{ around.
Once we clear them out, we are done.
Finish up fast and meet back here.
Kid has no charm at all. At least he is good at the job...
Looks like things are mostly settled...
Hmm... }Central Tower{ is right above here.
Better remember this path. It might help our plan.
Kid, I already finished my side. Let us get back and get paid.
Not mine. You can toss it.
Hey, hey, what took you so long? Flirting with the goblins?
That is all you have to say? Cold kid, really.
This job. Does not it seem suspicious when we do not even know the client?
Nobody hiding their face is up to any good. You will regret it if you get dragged into something messy.
Not my business. That is for the guild to sort out.
If they hired someone to clear the underpass, their combat ability is likely low...
If you want to earn coin, it is better to camp the path and catch the runaway.
If that foolish guild master listened to me, he might actually be useful.
Judging by the mood, he will not be caught easily... but buying some time would help...
Huff... huff... To run into someone like that in a place like this...
What was that...? A servant of that red-haired man...? Or House Wade secret weapon...?
Facing it right now is suicide...!
What happened? Did the red-haired man get you?
Damn it... I never should have... gotten involved with the tower...
Answer me! Where did he go?
What is that... It is not an Ancient either...?!
Could that be... the secret weapon he talked about?!
R-Run... We are all going to die...!
Is it too narrow... for it to enter?
No... It will break through soon...! We need to get out of here!
Locked...?! I might be able to break it down, though...
I need time... I have to hold out somehow...!!
G A M E  O V E R
EVENT_You should not have won... Hidden Ending.
Hey... Give me a break with this rotten luck...!!
You are... the last of... House Bane...
I do not care if you are House Wade pet monster or that guy secret weapon...
Like hell I am gonna die here to some nobody!!
^I will grant you what you desire most.
Or is it... a dream? This voice...
Damn it... Is my final dream really this piece of crap...?
What is this... What do you want from me?
Succession? What the hell am I supposed to succeed...?!
You will grant what I desire most? Who the hell do you think you are?!
I told you, I am not making a contract with someone I do not even know!
I will not die... I am not gonna die...!
Heh... What, you are not a recording? You can say other things too, huh...
Then what? If it is what I desire... most...
Are you saying you can bring me back from the dead...?
I will not... die... Not like this...
Answer me! What am I succeeding...?!
What will I end up owing you?!
^In the battle against all other Successors...
^You must emerge as the final victor...
It seems the final succession is complete.
I do not think we will be satisfied if you just run away like this.
Sorry, but... I am afraid I will be the next test subject.
Afraid, huh? Does an immortal monster like you actually feel such emotions?
Please come back. If you disappear like this, we will have no choice but to doubt everything you have done.
You were never a Listener, Isabel.
If I were a Listener, this place would already be surrounded.
That is why I am asking...
Are not you afraid at all? Of everything you have done, and everything you will do?
I am not afraid. Because our greater cause is one and the same.
If you fear nothing for the sake of such a cause...
Then you are the monsters, humans.
All for the Republic... No, for humanity.
I did not expect to leave so soon. You are much more capable than I thought.
If my personality falls short, my skills better make up for it.
I just hate putting off what needs to be done.
A man of clean, decisive work. Come back next time, I will have good jobs for you.
You had better hurry aboard, we set sail immediately...
Just checking. To see which one of you is the Successor.
Oho... Oho... She vanished? Then that sweet little girl is the Spirit, and...
That makes you the Successor, does not it?
Go on ahead! I will catch up soon!
Get going! This guy must be one too...!
You are a }Successor{... are not you?
Oho... You have been waiting too, have not you? For the battle between Successors!
Cut the crap... I am still trying to wrap my head around whether to believe any of this!
I waited... waited until I was sick of it... In this clash of Successors...
To emerge as the ultimate victor... Heheheh...
What the hell is with this maniac?!
Oho, oho. Not bad. Not bad at all.
Then how about I use, say, three fingers?
|(Damn it... He is not joking...! This guy is barely even trying...!)
|(And he is completely out of his mind. He is dangerous!)
It will not be pretty if you ruin the thrill of my hunt like this...
}Alfred{... The time has come. Cannot we start already?
Not yet. That man has fled.
You never trusted him in the first place, did you? Heheheh...
We will not move without certainty. We cannot repeat what happened with Kefnes.
More importantly, securing a hazard like you takes priority.
Heheheh, you still think you can catch me?
Out of generosity, I will take you on with one hand!
Even with the Black Guard and a commander like }Alfred{ showing up...
He slipped away like it was nothing... Having an enemy like that...
And maybe the Black Guard are hunting the Successors too.
Feels like I have taken on an absurd burden...
Be... careful... I can still... sense that man nearby...
Wait, never mind that, your wounds...!
I am okay... With some rest... I will recover...
This is not the kind of wound you just sleep off!
I am... a spirit, after all... If I dematerialize and rest for a day...
Fine by me. I am walking to Rockville on Vernal anyway. It is easier alone.
Wait... what about the boat trip...?
You are in that state and still worrying about that?
If the Black Guard is on the move, no place in Central is safe. A ship is out of the question.
I will handle it myself, so get back inside.
Getting injured on top of everything... what a hassle. Why did she even materialize...?
Phew. Guess I am crossing Twilight Bridge after all this time. Let us head south.
Guess I have no choice but to break through the front...
I have to take them all down before I am surrounded...!!
G A M E  O V E R
What on earth is that now...?
Good, the Bridge Guard stopped him! Close the perimeter! Quick!
Damn, I have come too far to turn back now...!
Well... better than that monster in the underpass. I just have to push through!
A Successor... You lot never do come quietly, do you?
Rufus is one thing, but to think a kid like you would give us this much trouble...
Why is... House Wade Black Guard hunting Successors?
Do you even know what a Successor is?
Beings that must die... That is all.
Meaning... a threat to the }Hearers{, right?
...I have no idea what you are talking about.
Too late. Your reaction gave it away.
A pointless stall. I have nothing to tell you...!
Surround him! End this before the spirit true nature awakens!
A spirit...?! It has a physical form?!
Sorry, but you will have to play by yourself now!!
I knew Successors would put up a good fight...!
Now, should I fight with one hand this time...?
It is your first time on a ship... Guess you do not get seasick.
Hey hey, what are you doing over there?
This route is }Ancient{ territory. Is not that dangerous?
There are plenty of regular troops on board... The ship is safe it is you who are in danger.
Hurry back and hide! I do not want things getting blown out of proportion.
I have a bad feeling about this.
Like I said, that is not what you should be worrying about!
A stowaway, huh... Well, that is a common sight.
What is with you? Your face is completely red.
Damn it... picked the wrong ship.
Huh? M-me? I am... just Ren...? Without the El...
Ah, my apologies. Mistook you for someone else.
Blonde hair... with something strange on his arm... Feels like I have seen him somewhere...
You too, Schultz? I... feel like I have seen him somewhere before too.
You were just born... There is no way.
At least he does not seem like an ordinary stowaway.
Eileen, are you alright? Pull yourself together!
Impressive. Are all high-ranking army officers like this?
Over there! Brian is over there!
I will be taking my leave. If you are Successors, and plan to oppose House Wade...
I am really starting to wonder who you are...
Likewise. Let us talk... next time.
Get a grip... She just... looks like her.
Land is not far, radio the pier! Do not let him get away!
Did you just... call him that?
Huh...? Did I... call him that?
Hey, are you a mercenary? Where are you from? Does it pay well? I wanna be one too...
Because of the Ancients, almost all ships out to sea are controlled by the Council these days.
Well, it is true Ancients attack ships every now and then, but still...
Moytura Isle still relies on farming, so it is one of the least industrialized islands.
When going on vacation, that kind of place has its own charm, even if it is inconvenient.
Hey mercenary, let us keep things quiet, okay? Reporting anything just makes trouble.
What man... are you talking about...?
Do not be nervous, just curious. Stowaway stories are fun, you know.
Gah... scared me. You a mercenary? Kids these days have no manners at all...
If he is not even allowed on deck, he must be a pretty famous fugitive.
Cannot you tell by that thing on his arm? That man is }Brian{.
Yeah, you know it, right? So do not go chasing bounties. Let us just keep things peaceful, alright?
Talking about peace when you smuggled a guy like that aboard?
I did not smuggle him. I was just lucky enough to spot him first after he snuck on...
If someone that big clashes with the Regular Army mid-voyage... It is terrifying just thinking about it.
Hmm... So that is why you hid him.
Yeah. Stay hidden in the }Storage{ until Moytura, and nothing will happen. Just leave him alone.
Brian... I have never heard of him. Was that that guy name?
He was a high-ranking officer who betrayed the Regular Army during the Sanctuary War. A top-tier fugitive House Wade is desperate to catch.
We might just get some high-level intel in an unexpected place...
His name... I do not think that is it, though...
A story event will proceed. Saving and returning will be restricted for a while. Proceed?
The storage... It is locked, though poorly.
Looks like this is the storage... It is locked pretty loosely.
Is someone named Brian hiding in there? Will not it be dangerous?
You might not know, but Brian is a wanted man House Wade is desperate to catch.
Our goals might align... We cannot let an opportunity like this slip away.
Do not want to meet him?
No, no. Just... I am a bit nervous...
Fine. I will do the talking.
Hey... an attack like that would kill an ordinary person...
Ordinary people do not pick the lock of a storage door.
Sorry to disappoint, but no. Though I have kept a low profile lately, plenty still recognize me.
If you are looking for the fugitive, that is me. But my name is not Brian. It is Tyr.
Well, the name on the wanted poster hardly matters.
Anyway, it has been a while since I rode a ferry, so I would prefer a quiet trip. What do you want?
Whatever it is you have that can threaten House Wade...
For years, you have been the fugitive House Wade wants most. What made you that way?
Betraying them in the war is not reason enough. You have something more.
There are some things in this world you are better off not knowing.
How do you know about them?
I do not know who they truly are. But... I found out they are the force behind House Wade.
We are preparing in our own way to fight House Wade, too.
We? Who on earth are you...
An Ancient? Are we under attack?!
I knew I had a bad feeling about this...!
Hold on. Let us finish these guys off first.
Life on Cole Creek Isle was better under House Reedmeyer...
Since House Wade took the council, ore sells well, but prices keep rising.
Ugh... What do we do? Sounds like they are still fighting on deck...
I am going to Irem on his advice, but I am uneasy deep down.
Prices might be stable, but farming will be the main work after all...
I heard ancients only eat human entrails... Help me...
Moytura was once heavily anti-council, but now it seems quiet.
The rebels launched a big uprising four years ago, but failed utterly.
No way... There are many regulars aboard. It will not sink...
Heh, I am from Lorahan Isle. It is small, but my goods are top-notch. Care to look?
Hey, if you are a mercenary, fight! You want to live, right? Leave support to me!
...So you accepted succession the moment you had that dream.
I had no choice. I was in a wheelchair, helpless without others aid.
I brushed it off as nonsense for a year... Desperation makes all the difference.
Still, to regain life... nothing is more precious than that, right?
At least... it beats a cave full of gems.
Probably... But I do not know what Rufus or Chris gained.
I want to see the sea...
Everyone seeks different things, and their spirit powers vary too...
Yeah. Though I do not know why my spirit is especially annoying...
Whew... I am stepping out for a bit.
Still, you take good care of it.
I am just doing what I always do on ships.
People from many islands gather here. It is a chance to hear outside news.
Whatever, let us go! I want to see the sea!
I will rest here for a bit... I do not travel by ship often, so I feel unwell.
Come forth... Servant of the Descendant...
